inputs.text: [excited] ar… kee… OP… ter… iks. In Greek, "archaeo" means ancient, very old. [serious] And "pteryx" is wing. [curious] So what does that give us?
[happily] There you go. [proud] It lived in Europe, in Germany, one hundred fifty million years ago — it's one of the very first birds we know of.
[gasps] A bird that lived with the dinosaurs?
[serious] Exactly. [amazed] And it wasn't quite a bird like the ones we have today.
